food.storage_default_html: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, store in an airtight container. Breads and cakes can be frozen on the day they arrive.
food.delivery_default_html:
Fresh items are packed on the morning they leave us and sent by tracked delivery. Delivery days and costs for your address are shown at checkout.

Food cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. If something arrives damaged or not as described, contact us within 48 hours and we will put it right.

contact_form.heading: Write to the stall
contact_form.intro_html: Questions about an order, an allergen or trays for a gathering? Send us a note and we reply by email within one business day.
contact_form.success_message: Thank you. We will reply within one business day.
contact_form.info_hours_html:
Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 to 17:00
Sunday and Monday, the oven rests

home_bake_schedule.heading: When the tannour is lit
home_bake_schedule.text_html: Every baking day follows the same order. Orders placed by 14:00 join the next morning's fire.
home_bake_schedule.small_print: We bake from Tuesday to Saturday. Times are a guide.

home_ingredients.heading: What goes into kleicha
home_ingredients.text_html: Short lists, real ingredients. This is exactly what is in our date filled kleicha.
home_ingredients.ingredients_html: Wheat flour, butter, Zahdi date paste, milk, sugar, sesame, cardamom, nigella seeds, yeast, salt.
home_ingredients.disclaimer: Made in a kitchen that handles nuts, sesame and gluten. Always check the label on the pack.

home_menu_board.heading: The whole board
home_menu_board.text_html: Everything on the stall, written up the way it is on the board.

home_visit.heading: Baking days
home_visit.note_html: Order any day. Fresh bread leaves the oven and our kitchen on baking days, pantry goods every weekday.
